title: The CV PDF is already at 2 of its 2-page maximum: adding CV content means removing something else
body: scripts/pdf-output.check.ts asserts `pages <= 2` for both locales (the 2-page rule is a CV-strategy decision, not a test quirk). Both PDFs currently fill both pages, so any extra achievement, role, skill, section, longer Prose.short on a cv-ats surface, bigger font/margin in src/styles/cv.css, or a looser `PRIORITY_CUTOFF`/`MAX_ACHIEVEMENTS_PER_ROLE` in content/schema/resolve-view.ts can push it to 3 and fail `pnpm run test:pdf` (after `pnpm run pdf:local`). English text runs longer than Spanish, so check content.en.json too, not just the Spanish one. Do not raise the limit or shrink type to fit: cut or lower the `visibility.priority` of something else, or ask the author what to drop.
not_derivable: The check states the ceiling but not that the current CV already sits exactly on it; that only shows up after a build + PDF render, long after the edit.

evidence.summary: Measured 2026-08-25 (README limits table): both PDFs at 2 of 2 pages.
